title: Krishna Traders Draft Version 4 go-live frontend readiness and verification

requirements.summary: Prepare the frontend build for production go-live and add a lightweight verification checklist ensuring required routes, SEO files, header branding, and contact CTAs work in the deployed build.
acceptanceCriteria: Production deployment completes successfully without build errors.
Public site loads successfully and the header displays the brand text “Krishna Traders” on all main pages.
Routes for Home (/), Products (/products), About (/about), Contact (/contact), and Admin (/admin) are reachable in the deployed build.
/robots.txt and /sitemap.xml are served and accessible in production.
Contact CTAs (Call, Email, WhatsApp) remain functional after deployment.

file_operations.description: Add a small go-live routing normalization so direct navigation to /, /products, /about, /contact, and /admin still loads correctly even with the existing hash-based router (e.g., map non-root window.location.pathname into the appropriate hash route before rendering).

Harden CTA link generation for production by normalizing the phone numbers used in tel: links (strip spaces/dashes while preserving leading '+') to reduce device/browser incompatibilities and ensure Call/Email/WhatsApp CTAs remain functional after deployment.
Verify production correctness of robots.txt contents (allow rules and sitemap reference) and adjust only if required to ensure it is served as expected in the deployed build.
Verify sitemap entries align with the deployed public routes (Home, Products, About, Contact) and update only if needed for production consistency while keeping it accessible at /sitemap.xml.

Create a concise go-live verification checklist covering: successful build, public accessibility, header brand text presence, reachability of /, /products, /about, /contact, /admin, accessibility of /robots.txt and /sitemap.xml, and functional Call/Email/WhatsApp CTAs in production.
